info.name: NASA Astronomy Picture of the Day () APOD API
Get Astronomy Picture of the Day

params.name: api_key
params.description: api.nasa.gov key for expanded usage. Use DEMO_KEY for limited testing (30 requests/hour, 50 requests/day).

params.name: date
params.description: A string in YYYY-MM-DD format indicating the date of the APOD image. Defaults to today's date. Must be after 1995-06-16, the first day an APOD picture was posted. Cannot be used with count, start_date, or end_date.

params.name: start_date
params.description: A string in YYYY-MM-DD format indicating the start of a date range. All images in the range from start_date to end_date will be returned in a JSON array. Cannot be used with date or count.

params.name: end_date
params.description: A string in YYYY-MM-DD format indicating the end of a date range. If start_date is specified without an end_date then end_date defaults to the current date. Cannot be used with date or count.

params.name: count
params.description: A positive integer, no greater than 100. If specified then count randomly chosen images will be returned in a JSON array. Cannot be used in conjunction with date, start_date, or end_date.

params.name: concept_tags
params.description: A boolean True|False indicating whether concept tags should be returned with the rest of the response. Concept tags are derived from common search tags associated with the description text. Defaults to False. Note: concept_tags functionality may be disabled in the current service deployment.

params.name: hd
params.description: A boolean True|False parameter indicating whether or not high-resolution images should be returned. Present for legacy purposes only — it is always ignored by the service and high-resolution URLs are returned regardless.

params.name: thumbs
params.description: A boolean parameter True|False indicating whether the API should return a thumbnail image URL for video files. If set to True, the API returns URL of video thumbnail. If an APOD is not a video, this parameter is ignored.

items.docs: Returns the Astronomy Picture of the Day with title, explanation, image URL, HD image URL, media type, copyright, and optional concept tags. Supports date-based filtering, date-range queries, and random image selection. Cannot combine count with date or start_date/end_date.
